# VOLAMP ELEKTRIKALS PRIVATE LIMITED
> B2B industrial electrical distribution platform in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, supplying certified power cables, switchgear, and earthing infrastructure nationwide across India.

Volamp Elektrikals Private Limited is an authorized distributor, channel partner, and stockist of genuine industrial cables and electrical equipment. Authorized channel partner and distributor for Polycab India, Finolex Cables, KEI Industries, Schneider Electric, L&T (Lauritz Knudsen), and Dowells. Family electrical business legacy dating to 1964; company incorporated in 2021 (CIN: U31900GJ2021PTC122730 | GSTIN: 24AAICV0754B1ZO | GeM Verified Reseller & Authorized Wholesale Distributor).

## Product Categories & Standards
- [Wires & Cables](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/category/wire-cables): LT/HT XLPE armoured power cables, control cables, and flexible copper wires (IS 7098 Part 1/2, IS 1554, IS 694).
- [Switchgear & Power Distribution](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/category/switch-gears): Air circuit breakers (ACB), MCCBs, MCBs, DBs, and contactors from Schneider Electric and L&T / Lauritz Knudsen.
- [Cable Lugs & Terminals](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/category/lugs): Dowells heavy-duty tinned copper crimping lugs, aluminium tubular terminals, and bimetallic lugs (IS 8337 / DIN 46235).
- [Conduits & Raceways](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/category/conduit): Rigid FRLS PVC conduits, Class 4 hot-dip galvanized (GI) steel conduits, and fittings (IS 9537).
- [Cable Glands & Management](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/category/glands): Brass single and double compression weatherproof/flameproof cable glands and termination kits (BS 6121 / EN 50262).
- [Industrial Wiring Devices](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/category/wiring-device): IEC 60309 industrial plugs & sockets, combination distribution boxes, and enclosed rotary isolators.
- [Earthing & Lightning Protection](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/category/earthing-material): Chemical earthing electrodes (CPRI tested), copper bonded rods, and GI earthing strips (IS 3043).
- [Solar & Renewable Cables](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/category/solar): 1500V DC solar PV cables (EN 50618 / IEC 62930), MC4 connectors, and solar array combiner boxes.

## Brand Portfolio & Core Lines
- [Polycab India](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/dealers/polycab-ahmedabad): Authorized channel partner for industrial LT/HT power cables, solar DC cables, and FRLS wires.
- [Finolex Cables](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/dealers/finolex-cables-ahmedabad): Authorized channel partner for electrolytic copper building wires and industrial flexible cables.
- [KEI Industries](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/dealers/kei-cables-gujarat): Authorized partner and star dealer for heavy industrial power cables, rubber trailing cables, and HT distribution.
- [Schneider Electric](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/dealers/schneider-electric-ahmedabad): Authorized distributor for Acti9, EasyPact MCCBs, contactors, and industrial protection switchgear.
- [L&T / Lauritz Knudsen](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/category/switch-gears): Authorized distribution partner for dsine MCCBs, motor starters, and power distribution boards.
- [Dowells](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/category/lugs): Authorized channel partner for heavy-duty copper terminal lugs and crimping accessories.
- [Legrand](https://www.volampelektrikals.com/category/switch-gears): Protection switchgear and industrial distribution enclosures.
